Body Characteristics: Medium-bodied with rounded mouth-feel from lees contact, showing harmony of maturity and liveliness.
Finish Characteristics: Clean and lingering with a light touch of minerality.
Aroma: Delicate ripe peaches and apricots, with notes of verbena.
Flavor: Vibrant and dry with stone fruit and subtle minerality; unoaked with a mellow texture.
Vinification: Cool fermentation followed by maturation on fine lees for 2–5 months to enhance texture and complexity.
Maturation: Aged for nine months on fine lees before bottling.
Color: Pale golden yellow with light green glints; bright and luminous.
Vineyard: Sloping right bank of the Serein river; south/south-east exposition
General Recommended Accompanies: Salmon en croute, trout in dill and cream sauce, or light summer salads.
Stella Recommended: Gamberi All Aglio, Baked Garlic Butter Lobster Escargot Style, Petrale Sole Piccata
Summary: This classic, unoaked Chablis from Domaine Séguinot-Bordet displays delicate stone fruit aromas and a bright, mineral-driven palate. Aged on lees for nine months, it offers texture and complexity while retaining vibrant acidity. Jean-Francois Bordet’s meticulous winemaking reflects centuries of tradition in Chablis.
Unique Summary: Unoaked and vibrant, this certified sustainable Chablis brings refined stone fruit and minerality from the limestone-rich slopes of the Serein valley.

Reviews.description: This juicy, thirst-quenching Chardonnay highlights crisp green-apple and lemon flavors lifted by streaks of lime acidity and steely minerality. Medium bodied and zesty, this approachable but elegant dry white would enhance anything from french fries to oysters on the half shell. Best enjoyed young.

Body Characteristics: Silky texture with vibrant acidity and rich tropical depth from Carneros and Coombsville fruit
Finish Characteristics: Juicy and refreshing with citrus zest and floral persistence
Aroma: Citrus, white floral, honeydew melon, and nectarine
Flavor: Lemon/lime zest, lemon verbena, melon, and stone fruit
Vinification: Fermented 89% in barrel and 11% in tank; no malolactic fermentation to preserve brightness
Maturation: Aged sur lie in French oak barrels (45% new, 55% once-used), medium toast
Vineyard: Blend of vineyard sites in Carneros and Coombsville
General Recommended Accompanies: Grilled halibut, lobster risotto with lemon butter, goat cheese salad, roast chicken
Summary: **Far Niente's 2023 Chardonnay** from Napa Valley combines cool-climate Carneros freshness with the depth of Coombsville. **Aged sur lie in French oak**, it offers a **silky texture, high acidity**, and flavors of **citrus zest, lemon verbena, and stone fruit**, finishing with elegance and energy.
Unique Summary: A barrel-aged Chardonnay with no malolactic fermentation, balancing vibrant citrus with creamy texture and floral aromatics.

Reviews.description: The combination of Carneros' maritime climate and the volcanic soils of Coombsville lends a hand in creating one of the most deluxe Chardonnays our team has had the pleasure of tasting. Augmented by sweet vanilla cream, elderflower, and white cherry, the mouthfeel is exquisitely graceful, and notes of key lime, herbed lemon, and luscious ripe pineapple are opulent to the end. Aged sur lie in French oak barrels.

Pure aromas of lemon confit, poached Asian pears, pastry and lanolin. The palate is medium-bodied with focused acidity and a creamy texture, giving notes of lime curd, orange blossoms, yellow apples and flint. Very well constructed and polished.

Elegant and fragrant up front, with notes of orange blossoms and ginger paste alongside fleshy, juicy flavors of ripe melon, peach, apricot and fresh lemon zest. Accents of smoked sea salt and fennel pollen linger on this white's sleek frame.

Wine Name: Chardonnay, Grgich Hills Estate, Napa Valley
Body Characteristics: Vibrant and juicy with natural acidity and layered tropical and citrus fruit texture.
Finish Characteristics: Flavorful and extended with juicy citrus and tropical notes.
Aroma: White peach, lemon, key lime, and coconut.
Flavor: Ripe citrus, Meyer lemon, mandarin, pineapple, mango, and hints of oregano.
Vinification: Fermented with indigenous yeast over 2–3 weeks in barrel; no malolactic fermentation to preserve acidity.
Maturation: Aged 10 months in French oak: 80% in barrels and 20% in foudres.
Type of cask: French oak (40% new, 60% neutral), including large-format foudres.
Vineyard: Estate vineyards in American Canyon and Carneros, southern Napa Valley.
General Recommended Accompanies: Seafood, poultry, creamy pasta dishes, and soft cheeses
Stella Recommended: Fiocchi con Peri e Taleggio, Pollo alla Calabrese, Piccata di Vitello
Summary: Grgich Hills Estate’s 2022 Chardonnay is a classically styled Napa white, estate-grown in cool Carneros and American Canyon. With vibrant acidity and no malolactic fermentation, this wine highlights bright citrus, tropical fruit, and subtle herbal notes over a long, layered finish.
Unique Summary: Certified regenerative organic and naturally fermented, this Chardonnay showcases Napa’s coastal side with zesty precision and elegance.
Sustainability: Certified regenerative organic farming across all estate vineyards

Reviews.description: Creamy, with a focused woodsy character. Pear tart, chamomile, and honeyed banana lend depth and texture within a balanced, luxurious mouthfeel. Spiced pumpkin appears on the finish with a pinch of salinity.

This is aromatic with ripe peaches, pineapple, honeysuckle, praline and crushed stones. Full-bodied, dense and round-textured with a tangy, spiced nature. Shows tension and energy with mineral undertones at the end. Drink or hold.

Bright and lemony, with plenty of aromatic interest from the lemon verbena, lemongrass and vetiver accents, all on a sleek frame. Details of lemon cream, Fuji apple, lime zest and salted shortbread come in on the finish. Drink now. 19,000 cases made.

Body Characteristics: Crisp and bright acidity with a velvety texture and balanced finish
Finish Characteristics: Lingering notes of pineapple and Bosc pear with citrus acidity
Aroma: Lime zest, Meyer lemon, green apple, white pear, white flowers, toasted almonds, and a delicate mineral note
Flavor: Lemon, minerality, pineapple, Bosc pear with crisp acidity and round texture
Vinification: Hand-sorted, whole-cluster pressed, free-run juice settled naturally, fermented in 75% French oak and 25% stainless steel
Maturation: Aged sur-lies for 9 months in French oak (14% new, rest one-year-old to neutral)
Type of cask: French oak (Remond, Rousseau, TW Boswell), stainless steel
Color: Pale straw with a slight green hue
Vineyard: Blend from six estate vineyards and selected growers in the Sonoma Coast
Summary: **Russian River Ranches Chardonnay 2023** from Sonoma-Cutrer showcases the Sonoma Coast’s cool-climate charm with **vibrant citrus, crisp acidity**, and a **long mineral-laced finish**. Fermented and aged in a mix of French oak and stainless steel, this wine reveals **lime zest, green apple, white flowers, and toasted almonds**, with elegant sur-lie complexity.
Unique Summary: A Sonoma Coast Chardonnay blending citrus vibrancy with sur-lie depth and mineral precision.

Reviews.description: Bright aromas of lemon peel, hazelnuts, pastry and flint. The palate is medium-bodied with bright acidity, giving notes of grapefruit pith, lime curd and spices. Generous, with a light touch.

Wine Name: Gavi di Gavi, La Scola, Piemonte
Body Characteristics: Delicate and dry with an acidulous vein and almond-like nuance.
Finish Characteristics: Pleasantly crisp with lingering freshness and subtle almond notes.
Aroma: Pleasantly fresh and elegant with a typical Gavi bouquet.
Flavor: Delicate and dry, with an acid-driven profile and almond hints.
Vinification: Traditional vinification in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks.
Color: Pale straw yellow with greenish hues.
Vineyard: Young vineyards located in Rovereto di Gavi, considered the Grand Cru of Gavi.
General Recommended Accompanies: Hors d'oeuvres, seafood, pasta with clams or pesto, white meats, vegetable tarts, or as an aperitif.
Stella Recommended: Orecchiette Primavera e Speck, Petrale Sole Piccata, Milanese di Pollo
Summary: This classic Gavi is produced from young vineyards in the renowned Rovereto di Gavi. It showcases a dry, crisp profile with bright acidity and almond nuance, expressing the elegant essence of Cortese. A quintessential Italian white with DOCG pedigree.
Unique Summary: From Gavi’s Grand Cru zone, this DOCG white delivers bright acidity and subtle almond complexity in a refined, dry style.

Reviews.description: Crushed stones, fresh hazelnuts and stone fruit on the nose. It’s fresh and mineral with a medium body and a clean finish. Drink now.

Body Characteristics: Round and mouth-filling texture enhanced by lees aging, balanced by vibrant acidity and crisp minerality.
Finish Characteristics: Round and crisp mineral finish with lingering citrus and peach notes.
Aroma: Bright notes of citrus, yellow peach, pear, and spring flowers.
Flavor: Ripe peach, pear, citrus, layered fruit character with a mineral-driven finish.
Vinification: Fermented in stainless steel tanks with select yeasts to enhance the varietal aromas.
Maturation: Aged four months on lees with weekly battonage to enhance texture and complexity.
Vineyard: Friuli Colli Orientali, nestled in the foothills of the Austrian and Slovenian Alps.
Summary: Sourced from the Friuli Colli Orientali DOC in northeastern Italy, this 100% Pinot Grigio reflects the alpine foothill climate with vibrant acidity and crisp minerality. Aromas of citrus, yellow peach, pear, and spring flowers lead to a layered palate with ripe stone fruit and a round, textured mouthfeel from four months on lees. Stainless steel fermentation preserves purity and freshness, resulting in a refined and expressive northern Italian white.
Unique Summary: Weekly battonage and four months on lees give this alpine Pinot Grigio an uncommon roundness and layered texture while preserving its crisp mineral precision.

Reviews.description: Lifted and fresh aromas of green and Golden Delicious apples with subtle hints of lemon peel and white flowers grace the glass. The fleshy palate is generous with mixed stone fruits and blanched almonds, finishing with a pop of acidity.
Fresh and balanced, with a citrusy overtone of grapefruit pith and citronella, this shows flavors of crunchy white peach, chive blossoms and minerally saline and stone, followed by a creamy finish.

Wine Name: Pinot Gris, Ken Wright "Tyrus Evan", Willamette Valley
Body Characteristics: Richly textured palate with a mouthcoating, silken finish and soft acidity.
Finish Characteristics: Silken and lingering with floral and ripe orchard fruit notes.
Aroma: Ripe yellow pear, white peach, honeysuckle, lemon curd, and chamomile.
Flavor: Juicy pear and peach, citrus curd, chamomile, and floral tones with gentle weight.
Vinification: Hand-selected and blended by Ken Wright and his son Carson Evan; details not specified beyond varietal purity and AVA.
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal with seafood, shellfish, and light white meat dishes.
Stella Recommended: Gamberi All Aglio, Baked Garlic Butter Lobster Escargot Style, Petrale Sole Piccata
Summary: Crafted in the Willamette Valley by Ken Wright and his son Carson, the 2022 Tyrus Evan Pinot Gris delivers ripe orchard fruit, citrus, and floral notes in a richly textured style with a long, silken finish. A graceful expression of Oregon Pinot Gris.
Unique Summary: Blended by Ken Wright and his son, this Pinot Gris is a tribute to family and showcases ripe fruit and texture from the Willamette Valley.

Wine Name: Rosé, Langhart & Hill, Russian River Valley
Body Characteristics: Mouth-filling with vibrant acidity and delicate berry texture
Finish Characteristics: Racy and fresh with lingering citrus and mineral edge
Aroma: Pink grapefruit, carnation flowers, tangerines, and minerality
Flavor: Citrus and floral notes with hints of berry and refreshing acidity
Vinification: Hand-harvested pre-dawn, partially crushed, 2-hour cold soak for color, inoculated with Cross Evolution yeast, cool fermented
Maturation: Stainless steel fermented and aged to preserve freshness
Vineyard: Hill Family Vineyard, middle reach of Russian River Valley near Healdsburg
General Recommended Accompanies: Light salads, pasta and rice dishes, seafood, and grilled chicken
Summary: **Langhart Hill's 2022 Rosé**, crafted from **100% Merlot clone 181**, bursts with aromas of **pink grapefruit, tangerine, and florals**. Grown in the heart of the **Russian River Valley**, it’s fermented cool in stainless steel, preserving **vibrant acidity**, a delicate **radiant pink color**, and a **racy citrus-mineral finish**.
Unique Summary: A floral, citrus-driven Rosé made entirely from Merlot clone 181 and fermented in stainless steel for purity and freshness.

Body Characteristics: Crisp and refreshing, light-bodied with vibrant acidity and gentle texture.
Finish Characteristics: Mineral-driven with citrus zest and tropical notes that linger cleanly.
Aroma: Pink grapefruit, lemon curd, fresh pear, melon, passionfruit.
Flavor: Citrus, kiwi, lemon zest, mango, guava, and pineapple.
Vinification: Hand-picked at night, whole-cluster pressed in an anaerobic environment, fermented in stainless steel tanks (95%) and concrete eggs (5%) with temperature control.
Maturation: Aged 5 months in 64% neutral French oak, 32% stainless steel, and 4% concrete egg.
Type of cask: Neutral French oak, stainless steel, and concrete egg.
Vineyard: Estate and sourced vineyards in Carneros, Suscol Springs, Rutherford, and Calistoga.
General Recommended Accompanies: Perfect with seafood, fresh salads, and vegetable dishes with citrus or tropical fruit accents.
Stella Recommended: Petrale Sole Piccata, Milanese di Pollo, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio
Summary: Cakebread’s 2023 Sauvignon Blanc blends citrus zest and tropical flavors with crisp acidity and a mineral finish. From Napa and North Coast vineyards, this wine shows elegance and freshness, aged in a mix of oak, steel, and concrete to enhance texture and expression.
Unique Summary: A vibrant, light-bodied Sauvignon Blanc layered with citrus and tropical notes, crafted with precision using oak, stainless steel, and concrete egg aging.

Body Characteristics: Bright and crisp with zesty acidity and a lively tropical profile.
Finish Characteristics: Clean, refreshing, and mouthwatering with lingering citrus notes.
Aroma: Pineapple, kiwi, and tropical fruit with citrus zest.
Flavor: Grapefruit, key lime, and tropical fruit with a bright, juicy character.
Vinification: Fermented and aged in stainless steel to preserve freshness and aromatic purity.
Vineyard: Estate vineyards certified Napa Green and Fish Friendly Farming.
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal with seafood, citrus-dressed salads, or light appetizers.
Stella Recommended: Gamberi All Aglio, Heirloom Burrata, Petrale Sole Piccata
Summary: The 2023 PEJU Legacy Sauvignon Blanc captures the freshness and vibrancy of a long, cool growing season in Napa’s North Coast. Tropical fruit, citrus, and mouthwatering acidity define this clean and elegant stainless-steel-aged wine.
Unique Summary: Certified sustainable and stainless-steel aged, this Sauvignon Blanc bursts with pineapple, kiwi, and grapefruit over crisp acidity.
Sustainability: Certified Napa Green and Fish Friendly Farming across estate vineyards

Body Characteristics: Refreshing yet rounded structure with balanced weight and elegance
Finish Characteristics: Pleasant and clean with lingering citrus and light spice
Aroma: Pink grapefruit, lemon, light spice, bread crust
Flavor: Citrus-driven with grapefruit and lemon, subtle spice, and savory bread notes
Vinification: Partial early harvest with skin maceration for pied de cuve, spontaneous fermentation, remaining grapes softly pressed and fermented in stainless steel at controlled temperatures
Maturation: Aged 70% in stainless steel and 30% in tonneaux for 5 months
General Recommended Accompanies: Perfect as an aperitif, pairs well with fish dishes and moderately mature cheeses
Summary: This Vermentino di Sardegna DOC showcases **bright citrus notes of grapefruit and lemon**, layered with **subtle spice** and **bread crust complexity**. Crafted with partial skin maceration and spontaneous fermentation, it delivers a **fresh yet rounded palate** with **elegant** structure. A short maturation in steel and tonneaux **enhances balance and depth** while preserving its **vibrant character**.
Unique Summary: A biodynamic Vermentino blending freshness with texture through partial skin fermentation and spontaneous fermentation techniques.
Sustainability: Produced following BioIntegrale, organic and biodynamic farming practices with biodiversity-focused viticulture

Reviews.description: A fresh and clean white with aromas of slices apples, lemons, white blossoms and stones. Medium-bodied, polished, sleek and really delicious, with crunchy acidity and a lingering, citrusy finish. From biodynamically grown grapes with Demeter certification. Drink now.

Body Characteristics: Smooth body with fresh acidity and mineral structure
Finish Characteristics: Bright and refreshing with lingering citrus-mineral tone
Aroma: Green apple, green pear, white peach, and strong minerality
Flavor: Crisp citrus, orchard fruit, and stony minerality with vibrant freshness
Vinification: Alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel to preserve freshness and purity
Maturation: Aged for 4 months in stainless steel
Vineyard: Various estate vineyards in Alto-Adige and South Tyrol
General Recommended Accompanies: Light seafood, fresh salads, grilled vegetables, or as an aperitif
Summary: **Pertico Pinot Grigio** from **Castelfeder** showcases Alto-Adige freshness with aromas of **green apple, pear, and white peach**, balanced by a **mineral-driven, smooth palate**. Fermented and aged in steel, it’s clean, vibrant, and perfect for everyday refreshment.
Unique Summary: A mineral-rich, high-acid Pinot Grigio from South Tyrol’s alpine vineyards — crisp, fruity, and stainless-steel pure.

Body Characteristics: Bright and layered with varietal intensity, balanced acidity, and sur lie texture from 9 months of French oak aging.
Finish Characteristics: Lingering minerality with apple, peach, and spice notes lifted by floral elegance.
Aroma: Apple, peach, vanilla, spice, and floral notes.
Flavor: Cool-climate flavors of orchard fruit, spice, and vanilla with mineral depth.
Vinification: Harvested early morning, partial malolactic fermentation, regular bâtonnage.
Maturation: Aged 9 months sur lie in 100% French oak, 25% new.
Color: Pale gold with clarity and brightness.
Vineyard: Foley Family Estate and partner vineyards in Sonoma Los Carneros, Chalk Hill, and Russian River Valley.
General Recommended Accompanies: Ideal with roasted poultry, creamy seafood pastas, or herbed vegetable dishes.
Stella Recommended: Baked Garlic Butter Lobster “Escargot Style“, Fiocchi con Peri e Tallegio, Maiale con Pancetta e Aglio
Summary: Sourced from cool-climate vineyards across Sonoma, Chalk Hill’s 2023 Chardonnay balances varietal intensity with elegance. Aged in French oak, it delivers aromas of apple, vanilla, and peach with a long, mineral-laced finish.
Unique Summary: A bright, oak-aged Sonoma Coast Chardonnay showcasing fruit from Russian River, Carneros, and Chalk Hill sites.

Wine Name: Sauvignon Blanc, Dry Creek Vineyard, Dry Creek Valley
Body Characteristics: Crisp and refreshing with vibrant acidity and a lively fruit profile.
Finish Characteristics: Bright and clean with citrus, tropical fruit, and subtle herbaceous notes lingering.
Aroma: Meyer lemon, grapefruit, mango, jasmine, and geranium.
Flavor: Lime, peach, passion fruit, with hints of parsley, jalapeño, and white pepper.
Vinification: Fermented in stainless steel at 50–55°F for 22–24 days to preserve acidity and aromatics.
Vineyard: DCV3 estate vineyard, 12-year-old vines on sandy Yolo gravelly loam soils.
General Recommended Accompanies: Perfect with seafood, fresh salads, and dishes featuring herbs or citrus.
Stella Recommended: Gamberi all’ Aglio, Salmon Prosecco Buerre Blanc, Petrale Sole Piccata
Summary: This 2023 estate-grown Sauvignon Blanc from Dry Creek Valley offers vibrant citrus and tropical fruit layered with floral and herbaceous nuances. Stainless steel fermentation preserves its bright acidity and freshness.
Unique Summary: From the historic DCV3 vineyard, this Sauvignon Blanc blends crisp citrus and tropical fruit with floral and peppery complexity.

Reviews.description: This wine delivers a blast of fresh lime, ginger, and white flowers on the nose. The supple, textured palate brings bright flavors of citrus peel, pithy grapefruit, and spice before the floral energy of the finish takes over.
This white’s mix of fresh lemon, pear and pomelo is pure and focused, with hints of peach blossoms, creamy oolong tea and dried ginger. Lemon oil and fresh-clipped herb notes linger on the finish.

Body Characteristics: Balanced structure with a bright and expressive mouthfeel shaped by cool Carneros fruit and concrete tank fermentation.
Finish Characteristics: Clean and refreshing with lingering citrus and orchard fruit notes.
Aroma: Expressive citrus, pear, and green apple with delicate aromatics.
Flavor: Citrus, pear, and green apple supported by subtle mineral tones.
Vinification: Fermented in concrete tanks with malolactic fermentation limited to less than 10% to preserve freshness and fruit purity.
Maturation: Brief maturation in concrete tanks to maintain vibrancy and minerality.
Vineyard: Single vineyard site in Carneros influenced by Pacific Ocean cooling.
Summary: The 2021 Y3 Chardonnay from JAX Vineyards highlights vibrant citrus, pear, and green apple with fresh acidity and subtle minerality. Fermented in concrete tanks with minimal malolactic fermentation, it showcases a bright and balanced expression of Napa Valley Chardonnay.
Unique Summary: A Carneros-grown Chardonnay fermented in concrete with minimal malolactic influence, emphasizing pure fruit and minerality.
